audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate is called 'Grandmaster's Might' in whys[4], mid and wants.foe[2]. The ability is Grandmaster-at-Arms. Worse, Counter Strike was described only as 'dodges autos + stuns' with no statement of what it does NOT dodge — it evades basic attacks, so Bear Trap on a Rope and the Jousting dash damage still land through it. The full layer also wrote 'Beartrap' and carried no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies' — attacks, not abilities. Riot's R text gives him bonus Armor and Magic Resist plus magic damage on every third consecutive attack. Counter Strike is 17/15/13/11/9s, the longest cooldown in his kit and the whole punish window.
audit.corrected: Ability name fixed in all three places; the abilities-still-land rule and the 17s rank-1 number written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[5] and phases[1].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read Skill, Level 2 read Kled, Level 3 read Kled while whys[2] says he blanks your hardest early combo, and Level 6 read Skill while whys[4] says his ultimate outlasts you.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled / Skill / Jax / Skill / Jax / Kled / Kled and the mirror states it flipped rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 to exactly that with ratings moved, rows 3, 5 and 6 already agreeing.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 4 flipped in matched full/content pairs, ratings moved, the two contradicting phases whys rewritten, and whys[0] rewritten so the level-1 row claims level 1 for Kled with a reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty rested entirely on 'track Counter Strike' with no number and no bait method, and Empower — his 7s auto-attack reset — was never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Empower is a 7/6/5/4/3s reset, so the wind-up on his weapon is the tell that the burst is starting; that is the moment to step back, not the moment he presses Q.
audit.corrected: Counter Strike's 17s and the one-auto bait written into the cooldown block and do's; Empower named as the reset tell in the cooldown block and wants.foe[1].

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay close as you both stack — your W procs and remount sustain keep trades even-ish, so pick the fights where his E is on cooldown. notes: Real name error fixed: the page called Jax's ultimate 'Grandmaster's Might' in three places; it is Grandmaster-at-Arms. The most useful mechanical addition is that Counter Strike evades basic attacks only — Bear Trap on a Rope, the Jousting dash damage and the Chaaaaaaaaarge!!! ram all still land through it, so the correct bait is a single auto rather than holding the whole combo. wants.you[2] and several full-layer strings still say 'engage on Counter Strike's cooldown' without the number; they were already accurate so I left them.
